```{r Step 0: Ingest Data, include=FALSE}
ces2012 <- read_dta(here("00_rawdata", "CES_Data_PresidentialYears", "2012_ces.dta"))
ces2016 <- read_dta(here("00_rawdata", "CES_Data_PresidentialYears", "2016_ces.dta"))
ces2020 <- read_dta(here("00_rawdata", "CES_Data_PresidentialYears", "2020_ces.dta"))
ces2024 <- read_dta(here("00_rawdata", "CES_Data_PresidentialYears", "2024_ces.dta"))

```

```{r Step 1: Cleaning and Harmonizing Data, include=TRUE}
ces_2012_clean <- ces2012 %>%
    transmute(
    case_id = V101,
    year = 2012,
    votereg = votereg,
    newsint = newsint,
    employ = employ,
    race = race,
    birthyr = birthyr,
    gender = gender,
    party_id = pid7,
    ideology = ideo5,
    educ = educ,
    income = faminc,
    investor = investor,
    
    racial_resent_1 = CC422a,
    racial_resent_2 = CC422b,
    pres_approval = CC308a,
    age = year - birthyr
  )

ces_2012_clean <- ces_2012_clean %>%
  mutate(across(where(haven::is.labelled), haven::zap_labels))

ces_2016_clean <- ces2016 %>%
    transmute(
    case_id = V101,
    year = 2016,
    votereg = votereg,
    newsint = newsint,
    employ = employ,
    race = race,
    birthyr = birthyr,
    gender = gender,
    party_id = pid7,
    ideology = ideo5,
    educ = educ,
    income = faminc,
    investor = investor,
    age = year - birthyr,
    
    racial_isolated_1 = CC16_422f,
    racial_advantage_2 = CC16_422d,
    racial_anger_3 = CC16_422c,
    pres_approval = CC16_320a
  )

 ces_2016_clean <- ces_2016_clean %>%
  mutate(across(where(haven::is.labelled), haven::zap_labels))
 
ces_2020_clean <- ces2020 %>%
    transmute(
    case_id = caseid,
    year = 2020,
    votereg = votereg,
    newsint = newsint,
    employ = employ,
    race = race,
    birthyr = birthyr,
    gender = gender,
    party_id = pid7,
    ideology = ideo5,
    educ = educ,
    income = faminc_new,
    investor = investor,
    age = year - birthyr,
    
    racial_resent_1 = CC20_441a,
    racial_resent_2 = CC20_441b,
    racial_isolated_1 = CC20_440b,
    racial_anger_3 = CC20_441e,
    racial_advantage_2 = CC20_440a,
    pres_approval = CC20_320a
  )

ces_2020_clean <- ces_2020_clean %>%
  mutate(across(where(haven::is.labelled), haven::zap_labels))

ces_2024_clean <- ces2024 %>%
  transmute(
    case_id = caseid,
    year = 2024,
    votereg = votereg,
    newsint = newsint,
    employ = employ,
    race = race,
    birthyr = birthyr,
    gender = gender4,
    party_id = pid7,
    ideology = ideo5,
    educ = educ,
    income = faminc_new,
    investor = investor,
    age = year - birthyr,
    
    racial_resent_1 = CC24_441a,
    racial_resent_2 = CC24_441b,
    racial_isolated_1 = CC24_440b,
    racial_anger_3 = CC24_441e,
    racial_advantage_2 = CC24_440a,
    pres_approval = CC24_312a
  )

ces_2024_clean <- ces_2024_clean %>%
  mutate(across(where(haven::is.labelled), haven::zap_labels))

ces_panel <- bind_rows(
  ces_2012_clean,
  ces_2016_clean,
  ces_2020_clean,
  ces_2024_clean
) 

ces_panel %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ces_value_audit <- ces_panel %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(case_id, year),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, variable, value) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable, year, value)

ces_value_audit

audit_vars <- c(
  "race",
  "investor",
  "income",
  "party_id",
  "ideology",
  "gender",
  "educ",
  "employ",
  "racial_resent_1",
  "racial_resent_2",
  "racial_isolated_1",
  "racial_advantage_2",
  "racial_anger_3"
)

ces_panel %>%
  select(year, all_of(audit_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -year,
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    value = as.character(value),
    value = replace_na(value, "NA")
  ) %>%
  count(year, variable, value, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(year, variable) %>%
  mutate(
    pct = 100 * n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(variable, year, value)
```


```{r Step 2: Cleaning Data, include=TRUE}

ces_black <- ces_panel %>%
  filter(
    race == 2,
    income %in% 1:16
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    income_group = case_when(
      income %in% 1:3   ~ "Under $30k",
      income %in% 4:6   ~ "$30k–$59,999",
      income %in% 7:9   ~ "$60k–$99,999",
      income %in% 10:12 ~ "$100k–$199,999",
      income %in% 13:16 ~ "$200k+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    income_group = factor(
      income_group,
      levels = c(
        "Under $30k",
        "$30k–$59,999",
        "$60k–$99,999",
        "$100k–$199,999",
        "$200k+"
      )
    ),
    
    investor_binary = case_when(
      investor == 1 ~ 1,
      investor == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

ces_black <- ces_black %>%
  mutate(
    post = if_else(year == 2024, 1, 0)
  )

ces_black %>%
  count(year, income_group, investor_binary) %>%
  arrange(year, income_group, investor_binary)
```

```{r Step 3: Initial Modeling, include=TRUE}
m_resent1_2012 <- lm(
  racial_resent_1 ~ income_group * investor_binary,
  data = ces_black %>% filter(year == 2012)
)

m_resent1_2020 <- lm(
  racial_resent_1 ~ income_group * investor_binary,
  data = ces_black %>% filter(year == 2020)
)

m_resent1_2024 <- lm(
  racial_resent_1 ~ income_group * investor_binary,
  data = ces_black %>% filter(year == 2024)
)


m_resent2_2012 <- lm(
  racial_resent_2 ~ income_group * investor_binary,
  data = ces_black %>% filter(year == 2012)
)

m_resent2_2020 <- lm(
  racial_resent_2 ~ income_group * investor_binary,
  data = ces_black %>% filter(year == 2020)
)

m_resent2_2024 <- lm(
  racial_resent_2 ~ income_group * investor_binary,
  data = ces_black %>% filter(year == 2024)
)

plot_resent_gradient <- function(model, year, outcome_label) {
  
  predictions <- emmeans(
    model,
    ~ income_group * investor_binary
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      investor_binary = factor(
        investor_binary,
        levels = c(0, 1),
        labels = c("Non-stock owner", "Stock owner")
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(
    predictions,
    aes(
      x = income_group,
      y = emmean,
      group = investor_binary,
      linetype = investor_binary
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = lower.CL,
        ymax = upper.CL
      ),
      width = 0.1
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Income",
      y = outcome_label,
      linetype = "Stock ownership",
      title = paste0(year, ": ", outcome_label)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

plot_resent_gradient(
  m_resent1_2012,
  2012,
  "Racial resentment — Item 1"
)

plot_resent_gradient(
  m_resent1_2020,
  2020,
  "Racial resentment — Item 1"
)

plot_resent_gradient(
  m_resent1_2024,
  2024,
  "Racial resentment — Item 1"
)

plot_resent_gradient(
  m_resent2_2012,
  2012,
  "Racial resentment — Item 2"
)

plot_resent_gradient(
  m_resent2_2020,
  2020,
  "Racial resentment — Item 2"
)

plot_resent_gradient(
  m_resent2_2024,
  2024,
  "Racial resentment — Item 2"
)

p12 + p20 + p24

results_resent1 <- bind_rows(

get_gradient_predictions <- function(model, year, outcome) {
  
  emmeans(
    model,
    ~ income_group * investor_binary
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      year = year,
      outcome = outcome,
      investor = factor(
        investor_binary,
        levels = c(0, 1),
        labels = c("Non-stock owner", "Stock owner")
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      year,
      outcome,
      income_group,
      investor_binary,
      emmean,
      SE,
      lower.CL,
      upper.CL
    )
}

gradient_table <- bind_rows(
  
  get_gradient_predictions(
    m_resent1_2012, 2012, "resent_1"
  ),
  
  get_gradient_predictions(
    m_resent1_2020, 2020, "resent_1"
  ),
  
  get_gradient_predictions(
    m_resent1_2024, 2024, "resent_1"
  ),
  
  get_gradient_predictions(
    m_resent2_2012, 2012, "resent_2"
  ),
  
  get_gradient_predictions(
    m_resent2_2020, 2020, "resent_2"
  ),
  
  get_gradient_predictions(
    m_resent2_2024, 2024, "resent_2"
  )
)

gradient_table
```

```{r Step 5: Analysis of Variance Tests, include=TRUE}
m_resent1_2way <- lm(
  racial_resent_1 ~
    income_group * investor_binary +
    income_group * factor(year) +
    investor_binary * factor(year),
  data = ces_black %>%
    filter(
      year %in% c(2012, 2020, 2024),
      !is.na(racial_resent_1),
      !is.na(income_group),
      !is.na(investor_binary)
    )
)

m_resent1_3way <- lm(
  racial_resent_1 ~
    income_group * investor_binary * factor(year),
  data = ces_black %>%
    filter(
      year %in% c(2012, 2020, 2024),
      !is.na(racial_resent_1),
      !is.na(income_group),
      !is.na(investor_binary)
    )
)

anova(m_resent1_2way, m_resent1_3way)
```
